summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the bundled file math_init.js at npm install time. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob (string-array rotation via a WV8StW shuffler, a ~1000-entry mixed literal table, and an hc1jfK9 decoder) with no relation to the package's advertised Tamagui/Storybook decorator API (Kitt2Decorator/Kitt2Provider, ~1 KB of real code). Executing the payload under a separately-fetched Bun runtime causes install-time code execution outside of Node's introspection while the actual behavior of the obfuscated code cannot be determined from static reading. The package is published as @ornikar/kitt2 with repository URL pointing to github.com/ornikar/kitt.git, a naming/branding shape consistent with impersonation of the legitimate ornikar/kitt project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
